run_doctest_pickle3: run the doctest suite that validates pickle3_ext world class serialization and deserialization
test_pickle_world_reduce: test the pickle3_ext world class __reduce__ method returns correct class and arguments
test_pickle_world_greet: test the pickle3_ext world greet method returns expected greeting string after unpickling
test_pickle_world_secret_number: test the pickle3_ext world set_secret_number and get_secret_number methods preserve values across pickle roundtrip
test_pickle_world_attributes: test the pickle3_ext world instance attributes x, y, z are preserved after pickle dumps and loads
